subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Kafka and the Absurd Short Story
description: A quick win: understand Kafka and the Absurd Short Story.

hook.text: One morning, Gregor Samsa woke up and found he had turned into a giant insect. Nobody explains why.

buildup.text: Kafka's The Metamorphosis treats this horror with chilling matter-of-factness, as if bureaucracy caused it.

discovery.text: The story is about alienation: Gregor's family cares only about his lost income, not his suffering.

twist.text: Kafka asked his friend Max Brod to burn all his manuscripts after death. Brod refused and published everything.

climax.text: Kafka invented a new kind of short fiction where the nightmare is not what happens, but that nobody questions it.

punchline.text: The horror was not the bug but the family's indifference.

quiz.question: What happened to Kafka's manuscripts after his death?
options: They were burned as he requested
His friend refused to destroy them and published everything
They were lost for fifty years before being discovered
